title: WOFOST Crop Transaction True Process-Boundary Restart Qualification
goal: Qualify restart of the authoritative WOFOST crop transaction state across a real OS-process boundary using the F-KT13 trusted external reconstruction seam, without persisting retired accepted-window cache state.
qualified_boundary_to_preserve: F-WOF38 atomic crop publication remains the only crop-state publication route
F-WOF39 matching committed receipt retires accepted-window delivery/cache state only
F-KT13 external reconstruction creates a fresh committed runtime carrier and is not rollback
lineage, revision and committed time remain F-KT-owned provenance
kernel remains free of file/path/parser concerns

exclude: derived canopy or root-water views that can be recomputed

required_design: compose only the qualified F-KT13 reconstruction seam onto the F-WOF39 crop lineage under donor hash control
add owner-controlled persistence view/constructor APIs where private WOFOST state would otherwise require encapsulation-breaking access
keep byte/text encoding in an adapter or qualification layer outside src/kernel
use a fresh consumer process with no in-memory object transfer from producer
required_executable_claims: continuous crop path and process-restarted crop path are exactly identical at the qualified endpoint
producer terminates after writing the committed crop artifact
consumer reconstructs a fresh kernel_committed_state_t from the external artifact
restored crop owner and last-consumed-event receipt are exact
the same already-consumed event is rejected after restart
a subsequent distinct accepted crop event can commit after restart with monotonic revision and exact lineage/time continuation
accepted-window retired cache is not required for continuation
invalid schema/layout/codec/provenance or malformed crop-state payloads fail closed before a ready committed state is published
O0 and O2 qualification output is identical
nonclaims: not a production SWAP-wide restart format
not qualification of every WOFOST option or every optional crop state layout
not persistence of active unretired accepted-window delivery state
not permission for runtime code to set lineage or revision independently
not a branch-wide merge of the F-WOF and F-KT histories
decision_rule: Close positively only if a real producer-process to consumer-process restart preserves authoritative crop continuation and receipt identity, stale replay is rejected, a later event continues correctly, all negative payloads fail closed, preservation gates stay green, and no retired cache is promoted to persistent state.
